ordered_diagnoses: Autoimmune myopathy associated with B-RAF V600E mutation

s1.syndrome_frame: Subacute onset of skin and muscle symptoms following immunotherapy
salient_findings: Muscle weakness and limited joint mobility
Prominent erythema at nailfolds with capillary changes
key_facts: Patient is a woman in her 50s
Has stage IV B-RAF V600E mutant malignant melanoma
Metastases in liver, lungs, and peritoneum
Developed skin symptoms within 2 weeks of starting ipilimumab treatment
Received a second course of ipilimumab 14 months later
Experienced recurrence and worsening of symptoms
Physical findings include diffuse erythema and edema
Laboratory tests show elevated creatine kinase and C-reactive protein levels
Antinuclear antibody titer is 1:640 with speckled pattern
Jo-1 antibody is negative
MRI shows mild muscle hyperintensity
Muscle biopsy shows atrophy of type II muscle fibers without inflammatory myositis

shortlist: Autoimmune myopathy associated with B-RAF V600E mutation

shortlist.label: Dermatomyositis
shortlist.why_kept: Patient developed skin symptoms and muscle weakness after ipilimumab treatment, with elevated creatine kinase and C-reactive protein levels, and muscle biopsy showing atrophy of type II muscle fibers

shortlist.label: Ipilimumab-induced dermatomyositis
shortlist.why_kept: Patient developed skin and muscle symptoms after ipilimumab treatment, which is a known side effect of this medication

shortlist.label: Paraneoplastic dermatomyositis
shortlist.why_kept: Patient has stage IV malignant melanoma, and paraneoplastic dermatomyositis is a known association with various cancers

shortlist.label: Polymyositis
shortlist.why_kept: Patient has elevated creatine kinase and C-reactive protein levels, and muscle biopsy showing atrophy of type II muscle fibers, which are consistent with polymyositis

shortlist.label: Autoimmune myopathy associated with B-RAF V600E mutation
shortlist.why_kept: Patient has a B-RAF V600E mutation, which has been associated with autoimmune myopathies

raw.rationale: The patient developed skin symptoms within 2 weeks of starting ipilimumab treatment, and the symptoms recurred and worsened after a second course of ipilimumab, which is consistent with ipilimumab-induced dermatomyositis. The presence of diffuse erythema, edema, and elevated creatine kinase levels also support this diagnosis.

rejected.label: Dermatomyositis
rejected.why: While the patient's symptoms are consistent with dermatomyositis, the temporal relationship with ipilimumab treatment suggests a drug-induced cause.

rejected.label: Paraneoplastic dermatomyositis
rejected.why: Although the patient has malignant melanoma, the onset of skin symptoms after ipilimumab treatment and their recurrence after re-exposure to the drug suggest a drug-induced rather than paraneoplastic cause.

rejected.label: Polymyositis
rejected.why: The patient's muscle biopsy showed atrophy of type II muscle fibers without inflammatory myositis, which is not typical of polymyositis.

rejected.label: Autoimmune myopathy associated with B-RAF V600E mutation
rejected.why: While the patient has a B-RAF V600E mutation, the temporal relationship between ipilimumab treatment and the onset of symptoms suggests a drug-induced cause rather than a mutation-associated cause.
